result.stdout:
Usage: envvault [options] [NAMESPACE]

Cross-platform keychain-backed env-var manager. Envchain-compatible plus a Windows backend.

Options:
  --set                    Store one or more KEYs in NAMESPACE. Values come from an interactive prompt (or --value for non-interactive; single key only when combined with --value).
  --list                   With no NAMESPACE, list all namespaces. With a NAMESPACE, list its keys.
  --get                    Print the value of KEY in NAMESPACE to stdout.
  --unset                  Delete KEY from NAMESPACE.
  --allow-empty            Allow --set to store an empty string. By default envvault refuses empty values because silently storing "" is the exact footgun the tool exists to prevent (child command fails hours later with 'invalid credentials').
  --noecho                 Accepted for envchain compatibility (we never echo by default).
  --require-passphrase     Defer decryption to a passphrase prompt. Accepted as a flag but not yet implemented — returns an error until v1.1.
  --no-require-passphrase  Explicitly disable passphrase mode (default).
  --value VALUE            Explicit value for --set (alternative to stdin prompting). Be careful with shell history.
  -h, --help               Show help
  --version                Show version
  --color                  Force colored output
  --no-color               Disable colored output
  --json                   JSON output
  --describe               Structured JSON metadata for AI agents

Exit Codes:
  0    Success; in exec form, the child process's exit code is passed through
  125  Usage error: bad flags, missing positionals, mutually-exclusive action flags, or deferred feature used (--require-passphrase)
  126  Runtime error: key store unavailable, permission denied launching child command
  127  Not found: namespace or key missing on --get/--unset; command for exec form not on PATH
